artworks.title: L'inoculation de l'amour
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an indoor setting. One woman is seated on a bed, another woman stands next to her, and a boy kneels at the foot of the bed. The room contains a bed, draped curtains, decorative paneling on the walls, and a small table near the standing woman. The clothing and furniture suggest an 18th-century setting.

artworks.title: La confiance des belles âmes
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in front of a gate. In the center, a woman in a wide-brimmed hat and a dress is being held by two men. The man on her left wears a long coat and boots, while the man on her right is opening the gate. Behind them, there is a man loading a carriage, and a small dog is jumping. The background features a tall stone structure with foliage and the sky.

artworks.title: La barque
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a boat in turbulent waters surrounded by a landscape of mountains and trees. The boat is being tossed by the waves, and there is a sense of urgency and drama in the scene. The background features a mountainous landscape with trees and possibly a structure on a distant hill. The drawing employs detailed linework to capture the motion of the waves and the textures of the landscape.

artworks.title: Il appliqua sur cette main un baiser que je sentis sur mon coeur
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a room. Two women are standing close to each other at the center of the composition, while a third individual, possibly a man, is seated slightly to the right, leaning on a musical instrument. The woman to the left is shown in profile and wears an elaborate gown with voluminous skirts and intricate patterns, with styled hair. The woman to the right is also dressed in an elegant gown and styled hair. The seated individual rests their upper body on a harpsichord or piano with sheet music visible on a stand and a string instrument leaning against furniture. The decor includes heavy drapery and ornate furniture, suggesting luxury. The detailing and styling suggest a setting of affluence, with a focus on music and social interaction.

artworks.title: Elle s'élance après lui
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: Multiple full-bodied figures are descending down a grassy embankment towards a river. They are wearing period clothing suggesting an 18th-century style, with women in long dresses and men in coats and tricorn hats. The figures are in varied positions, some holding onto each other and some appearing to assist others as they move downward. In the river below, a part of a person's head and arm are visible. Trees and foliage are seen around the figures, with a serene landscape in the distant background featuring rolling hills and a village across the river. The sky is filled with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Julie s'évanouit dans un fauteuil
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with five people, displayed from head to toe. On the left, a person is seated on a chair with one arm raised towards a large window, while another figure on their left is standing with their arm also raised. The seated person has styled long curly hair, and their face is partially obscured. Two women in the center have ornate, curled hairstyles with ribbons or flowers and wear voluminous historical dresses. One woman is seated on furniture, while the other leans towards her. A man bends slightly towards the standing woman, with similarly styled hair pulled back, wearing elaborate historical clothing. There is no visible jewelry, but the detailed and rich texture of their clothing is evident. On the right, a doorway leads to another part of the room, and light from the window creates shadows in the elegantly furnished space. A framed portrait hangs on the wall, enhancing the sophisticated atmosphere of the room, which is elaborately paneled, exuding opulence and refinement.

artworks.title: Mort de Julie
artworks.artist: Robert Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: Three women are shown in a bedroom. One woman is standing, pulling aside a curtain, another woman stands behind her, extending her hand towards the third woman who is sitting up in bed. The women are dressed in long gowns with one wearing a shawl on her head. The woman in bed has her hair covered and is wrapped in blankets. The room is ornately decorated with curtains, a chair, and a table. An artwork hangs on the wall in the background.

artworks.title: Voilà la règle de la nature, pourquoi la contrariez-vous?
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This image depicts an elegantly furnished interior scene. In the room, there is a richly draped canopy bed to the left with a child holding a doll on a chair nearby. Another child is crawling on the floor towards adults seated at a table. On the right, two women are conversing at a round table with a tea set, while a third child looks on. The room features ornate paneling and a decorative piece above the doorway. The text below the image is in French, reading "Voilà la règle de la nature, pourquoi la contrariez-vous?," which translates to "This is the rule of nature, why do you oppose it?" The drawing displays intricate details showing the opulence and comfort of the room.

artworks.title: Chacun respecte le travail des autres, afin que le sein soit en sûreté
artworks.artist: Pierre-Philippe Choffard after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a natural setting. From left to right, there is a man holding a shovel, a young boy pouring water from a jug, and another man pointing towards the ground. The background includes lush foliage, a large tree, and a house in the distance. The scene suggests a garden or farm setting with planted rows of foliage.

artworks.title: Piqué de ma raillerie, il s'évertue et remporte le prix
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene in a rural setting. The image shows several figures around a small rustic building with a thatched roof, surrounded by trees. In the scene, a dog is engaging with the figures as they interact or play around the building. The setting includes steps, a low boundary wall, and a tree with detailed foliage. The sky above is partly cloudy, and there is a border with a French caption below the drawing.

artworks.title: Courons vîte: l'astronomie est bonne à quelque chose
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wooded landscape including a distant structure. The scene is set within a dense forest with large trees framing the composition. A path meanders through the woodland, leading to a clearing in the background where an architectural structure is partially visible. The drawing shows intricate hatching and delicate lines, typical of late 18th-century illustrative drawings. The caption in French at the bottom of the drawing adds to the enigmatic atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: La nature étaloit à nos yeaux toute sa magnificence
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing on a hill or cliff edge on the left side, looking outward across an expansive landscape. The horizon is high, revealing mountains, a valley, and a river. The technique involves intricate, scratchy lines with fine detailing, emphasizing texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, in various shades of brown. Trees frame the scene, with a vast landscape of rolling hills, fields, and scattered buildings along a river in the background.

artworks.title: Un violent exercice étouffe les sentimens tendres
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with a dog and two figures. The drawing depicts two individuals engaged in a conversation or instruction session in a natural setting. One figure is holding a large stick or pole, while the other is bending down by a small dog. The background features rolling clouds in the sky and distant trees, adding depth to the landscape. The ground is detailed with foliage and grass, indicative of a rural or wild environment with various plants depicted in the foreground. The artwork includes a caption in French.

artworks.title: Les folâtres jeux sont les premiers cuisiniers du monde
artworks.artist: Robert Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This image features a scene observed from a slightly high angle. There is no visible horizon within the frame, as the focal point is on the group of people. The illustration style uses fine, detailed linework typical of an engraving. Close to us, a group of individuals are gathered in a picnic setting, surrounded by lush grass, with items such as a basket and bottles scattered around them. In the distance, additional figures are partially obscured by the large trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Sophie remettez-vous
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image depicts five individuals in a historical-style setting around a dining table. Four individuals, three women, and one man, are seated while one woman is standing. They are all dressed in elaborate 18th-century attire, engaging in conversation and gestures. The setting includes a table with items like a candlestick and dishes, and a softly textured wall with an open cupboard displaying objects.

artworks.title: Il en est nâvré, je l'entraine avec peine
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures interacting within a room. The composition features a group of four individuals near the doorway of a classically designed room. The room has decorative elements such as a large wreath engraving on the back wall and detailed molding. The foreground features figures with elaborate clothing. The drawing captures a dynamic moment with expressive line work. The figures are dressed in period clothing. The details in the attire, posture, and surroundings contribute to a narrative composition that evokes themes of drama in a detailed architectural setting.

artworks.title: Le Devin du Village (Colette Weeping)
artworks.artist: Pietro Antonio Martini after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is an outdoor scene with figures and a tree. The drawing shows two figures standing under a large tree next to a building. The building has a window and a textured façade. In the background, there are rooftops and a distant structure resembling a church or castle with spires among trees. The lines and shading in the drawing emphasize texture and depth.

artworks.title: L'amant de lui-mesme
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the knee up in an interior setting. One man is seated with his back to a table, leaning slightly forward, holding a small mirror in one hand. He has long, curly hair and is dressed in period clothing. The other man stands facing him, slightly leaning forward. He has short, curled hair and is also dressed in period attire. The seated man is in an opulently decorated room with ornate furniture and wall panels.

artworks.title: Discours sur l'égalité des conditions: Il retourne chez ses égaux
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered outdoors. Two main figures are depicted, one standing in profile facing the other who is facing away. The first person is dressed in attire typical of the 17th or 18th century, with a long coat, shirt, stockings, shoes, and a wide-brimmed hat. They have European facial features and wavy hair under the hat. The second person is minimally clothed, wearing what seems to be a cloth around their waist. They are muscular and gesturing with their right hand. Several other men in similar period clothing, some with hats and swords, are also visible. The background includes a fenced area, buildings or structures, ships on the water, and clouds in the sky, suggesting an outdoor setting near a port or settlement. There is a bundle on the ground between the two main figures.

artworks.title: Pygmalion
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. The central figure is a nude female person standing on her tiptoes, partially draped with fabric. Her hair is styled in loose waves. To the left, a person is seated on the floor dressed in classical attire, reaching towards the central figure. To the right, another individual is partially visible, interacting with the central figure. In the background, tall columns and curtains frame the scene, creating an opulent setting, potentially a palace or mythological setting. Various objects like a shoe and a jug are scattered on the floor.

artworks.title: La découverte du nouveau monde
artworks.artist: Pietro Antonio Martini after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with individuals in detailed attire. The scene takes place in a structure with large wooden beams and a thatched roof, where a group of figures is gathered. These figures are adorned in elaborate attire, with feathered and draped garments, and some appear to be engaged with each other. Around them, several figures dressed in European-style clothing are present. The composition includes details like frilled sleeves and patterned skirts, emphasizing the richness of the costumes.

artworks.title: Iphis
artworks.artist: Robert Delaunay after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Roman military gathering. The scene showcases a group of Roman soldiers in a setting that suggests a meeting or discussion. The soldiers are depicted wearing classical Roman garb, including helmets, shields, and armored clothing. They are standing on a paved area, potentially a courtyard. In the background, there are more soldiers, some holding spears or standards. The sky is sketched in a way that suggests it is overcast or partially cloudy.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Dictionnaire de musique
artworks.artist: Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person outdoors among rocks and trees. The person is wearing a classical robe with long hair and a laurel wreath, holding a quill, with a lyre nearby. A globe is at their feet. The person has a serene expression, looking down. In the background, there is a temple-like structure with other figures nearby, possibly discussing or studying. The setting conveys a sense of classical antiquity and scholarly pursuits in nature.

artworks.title: J'ai tort, mon cher Valère, et t'en demande excuse
artworks.artist: Jean Jacques Le Veau after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in 18th-century clothing standing in an architectural setting with large columns in the background. The woman wears a dress and a cap, gesturing with one hand. The two men are dressed in coats, breeches, and stockings, with one wearing a tricorne hat. They appear to be interacting, with one holding a hat and the other's hand on his shoulder. The scene is set against classical architecture with columns and a stone floor.
